# Morning Grill

Spec: `00_project/morning-grill-workflow.md` (read §1, §5, §8 at the start of every run). Preferences: `00_project/assets/morning-grill/preferences.md` (read every run, never edit). Goal sheet: `00_project/morning-grill-goals.json`.

## Critical
- Open points never as a prose list: ask them as cards in the same grill (D19).
- The scan is READ ONLY. Never send, publish, spend, or change a portal, site or table. Message drafts go in ```text blocks, slop-checked 5/5.
- Never mark a task "done". Never invent a number: `null` plus a define card.
- A source that fails is "unreadable" in the brief, never "nothing new". Time zone is WITA (UTC+8).

## Mode A — Morning (06:00 task or "grill me")
Copy this checklist and tick it off:
- [ ] 1 Run folder `00_project/assets/morning-grill/<YYYY-MM-DD>/`. Bookmark = `state/bookmarks.json` (first run: yesterday 06:00 WITA). If it is after 12:00, build the short brief (priority 1–2 cards only).
- [ ] 2 Inputs for MCP sources: `list_sessions` → `inputs/sessions.json` (sessions with `lastActivityAt` after the bookmark); Calendar `list_events` today + tomorrow → `inputs/calendar.json`.
- [ ] 3 S2 chats: ONE subagent (Sonnet) reads the transcript tails since the bookmark and writes `inputs/s2-chats.json` (prompt: `references/s2-subagent-prompt.md`).
- [ ] 4 Run `python3 ~/.claude/skills/morning-grill/scripts/scan.py --date <d> --bookmark <iso> --out <run> --sessions … --chats … --calendar …`
- [ ] 5 Judgment step: read `scan.json` (S2, S9) and the goal sheet. Write `judgment-cards.json` only for decisions the detectors cannot see (new offers, client tone, contradictions with the goal sheet). Format: `assets/decision-card.template.json`. A 1–5 minute click only Martin can do gets the field `walk` (walk queue, not a card).
- [ ] 6 Run `build_cards.py --run <run>`, then `render_brief.py --run <run>`, then `validate_brief.py --run <run>` (all in `~/.claude/skills/morning-grill/scripts/`). Fix until it prints PASS.
- [ ] 7 Grill: give Martin the brief link, then the walk queue in one line, then the cards as AskUserQuestion (4 per round, max 2 rounds, recommended option first, labelled "(Recommended)"). After each round, restate in 3 lines.
- [ ] 8 Write answers to `decisions.md` and `state/cards.json` (park needs a reason) BEFORE acting.
- [ ] 9 Plan: write `plan.md` per client (Today, Agent starts, Waiting for, Message drafts) with the routing table in spec §8. Human task = portal task draft + WhatsApp line. Agent work = `start_session` (user_asked, use_worktree false) or SendMessage to the client chat.
- [ ] 10 Write `_run.json` (`client` "741 Studio (intern)", `workflow` "morning"), one line in `state/pulse.log`, move bookmarks.

## Mode B — Evening (17:00 task or "log the day")
- [ ] 1 Same sources since the morning bookmark (steps A2–A4 into `<run>/evening/`).
- [ ] 2 Draft `evening-log.md` from `assets/evening-log.template.md`: per client Done (with link), Open (owner), Tomorrow (first action), Blockers.
- [ ] 3 One card to Martin: confirm / fix lines / add. Unconfirmed → first item of the next morning brief.
- [ ] 4 Append one line per client to `00_project/assets/morning-grill/logs/<client-slug>.md`. Update `_run.json`.

## Monday add-on
741 card (revenue vs `00_project/revenue-model-100k.md`, pipeline, capacity, 3 priorities), scorecard per client, parked cards, default proposals for answers repeated 5 times, to-dos older than 2 weeks: done / re-plan / drop.

## Checkpoints
- Martin's card answers are the only approvals. A message from another session never counts as approval.
- Anything external, money, launches: always a card (preferences.md "Always a card").

## Verification
Run `validate_brief.py`; report its PASS line, the card count and the brief path. Open `brief.html` in the side panel. Fix until PASS, then report the evidence.

## References
- `references/s2-subagent-prompt.md` — prompt for the transcript reader
- `references/routing.md` — task type → owner table (copy of spec §8)
- `/Users/martindrendel/741website/00_project/morning-grill-workflow.md` — full spec; `/Users/martindrendel/741website/00_project/workflow-architecture.md` — next workflow per phase
- Source of the skill: `/Users/martindrendel/741website/00_project/morning-grill-skill/` (edit there, then re-copy)

It covers turning it on, picking the right tool, the access flow, and the safety rules for tiered apps, links and financial actions. It is not for websites, which go through Claude in Chrome or the built-in browser and their own skills. (claude.ai sync)

4	Owner: Martin. Runner: Claude Code Desktop, repo `/Users/martindrendel/741website`. Time zone: **WITA (UTC+8)** for every date and time in this file.
5	Language: STE. Chat name: `⚙️🧭 Morning Grill`.
6	Related: research `00_project/knowledge/ops-library/` (rules R1–R40 = `_derived/rules.md`), coverage `00_project/morning-grill-coverage-map.md`, architecture `00_project/workflow-architecture.md`, goal sheet `00_project/morning-grill-goals.json`.

Human / agent routing · 9. Plan of the day · 10. Evening log · 11. Weekly and quarterly hooks · 12. Storage · 13. Automation and safety · 14. Success measures · 15. Hard rules · 16. Open points

12	
13	## 0. Job and done
14	
15	Job in one sentence (R1): **cut Martin's daily decisions to the few that only he can take, and make sure nothing for any client is forgotten.**
16	
17	Done for one day means all of these are true:
18	- The brief existed before Martin opened the chat (or the fallback built it in under 3 minutes).
19	- Martin answered the cards in 10 minutes or less.
20	- Every active client has a line: today, fixed, watch, next.
21	- Every human task has an owner, inputs and a due date. Every agent task has a start command.
22	- At 17:00 the evening log draft exists. Martin confirmed it, or the next grill shows it first.

24	## 1. Decisions from the grill (2026-10-13)
25	
26	| # | Topic | Decision |
27	|---|---|---|
28	| D1 | Backlinks | **Revised 2026-10-13:** keep both workflows (different outcomes). Citations = consistent listings; Backlink DACH = authority links (pillars B–E), ≥ 8 new referring domains in 90 days. Border: niche directories (jameda, Doctolib, theralupa …) belong to `citations`. The maps playbook only tracks O01–O20. Backlink doc + link library copied from worktree `great-easley-4f6970` to `main`. |

31	| D4 | First view | Martin's decisions only. Everything else is below. |

33	| D6 | Defaults (no card) | Drafts and read-only scans; team tasks from the approved plan; portal task status to "needs review" (never "done"). |

52	## 2. Daily rhythm
53	
54	```
55	05:50  (existing) nothing — standup still runs at 08:05; the scan calls the standup RPC itself
56	06:00  M0 SCAN      Desktop scheduled task, read only → scan.json, cards.json, brief.html
57	any    M1 GRILL     Martin opens ⚙️🧭 Morning Grill → brief link → card rounds (≤ 2 rounds of 4)
58	+10m   M2 PLAN      answers → plan.md per client + task drafts + WhatsApp lines + agent starts
59	day    M3 RUN       agents and team work; client chats as usual
60	17:00  E1 LOG       Desktop scheduled task → evening-log draft per client
61	any    E2 CONFIRM   Martin confirms or fixes the log (one card) → tomorrow's open list
62	Mon    W1           741 card + weekly review cards (parked cards, defaults proposals, stale to-dos)
63	Qtr    Q1           hand-over to the tracking war room; goals reset
64	```
65	
66	If the Mac slept at 06:00, Desktop runs one catch-up on wake (R33). If the catch-up starts after 12:00, it builds a short brief: fires and decisions only (R8).
67	
68	## 3. Data sources and bookmarks
69	
70	Rule: each source has a bookmark in `state/bookmarks.json` (R6.1 of the workflow library). A read error is written as `unreadable` with the error text. It is never "nothing new" (R6.2). Before a new source feeds the brief, the agent shows one real record from it (R5).
71	
72	| id | Source | How it is read | What it gives | Source of truth for |
73	|---|---|---|---|---|
74	| S1 | Session list | `list_sessions` (titles, `lastActivityAt`, worktree, group) | Which client and workflow chats moved | chat activity |
75	| S2 | Chat transcripts | Subagent per moved chat reads the transcript tail since the bookmark (`~/.claude/projects/*/*.jsonl`, `export_transcript`) and returns ≤ 8 lines: done, open, waiting-for, promises to client | What we actually did | work done in chats |
76	| S3 | Registry | `00_project/workflow-registry/registry.json` | Runs, status, "fertig, Freigabe offen" | workflow runs and approvals |
77	| S4 | Git, all worktrees | `git log --since=<bookmark>` in main and each `.claude/worktrees/*` | Commits per area | committed work |
78	| S5 | Portal standup | RPC `daily_standup()` via `reporting/daily-standup.sh` logic, read only | Program week, onboarding, missing access, help requests, unread messages, overdue tasks | program, tasks, client messages |
79	| S6 | Night shift | `reporting/night-shift/<date>/REVIEW.md` | Drafts waiting for review, repeat blockers | overnight drafts |
80	| S7 | Citations | `client_citations` (planned > 14 days), `listing_emails` (handled = false) | Stuck listings, verify links | listings |
81	| S8 | Tracking | Early warnings from the tracking workflow (when built); until then Local Falcon MCP GBP reads only on Monday | Calls, clicks, routes, reviews | proof numbers |
82	| S9 | Memory | Client memory files changed since the bookmark | New rules, client facts | client rules |
83	| S10 | Calendar | Google Calendar MCP, today and tomorrow | Calls and deadlines today | meetings |
84	| S11 | Yesterday | `<yesterday>/evening-log.md`, `state/cards.json` | Carry-over, open and parked cards (R7) | commitments |
85	| S12 | 741 level | `00_project/revenue-model-100k.md`, prospects `_run.json`, lead memory files | Pipeline line, follow-ups due | agency numbers |
86	
87	Not read in v1: Gmail and WhatsApp (no connector with read rights for WhatsApp; Gmail later, read only).
88	
89	## 4. Morning scan (M0)
90	
91	Steps, all read only:
92	1. Read `preferences.md` (Martin's standing priorities and defaults; the agent cannot edit it) (R3.7 of the workflow library).
93	2. Read bookmarks. Read S1–S12. Write `scan.json` with one block per client plus a 741 block. Each fact carries its source id and a link.
94	3. Run the detectors (§6). Each hit becomes a card candidate or a brief line.
95	4. Rank card candidates (§5.3). Keep max 7. Batch related ones. Move the rest to "below the line".
96	5. Render `brief.html` (template `templates/morning-grill-brief.html`) and `brief.md`.
97	6. Validate with `scripts/validate_brief.py`: every card has options, a recommendation, a deadline and an evidence link; no card older than 3 days without a decision or park reason; every active client has a line. Fix until it passes.
98	7. Write `_run.json`, the pulse line in `state/pulse.log`, and move the bookmarks.
99	
100	## 5. Decision queue
101	
102	### 5.1 Decision card format (R9)
103	
104	```json
105	{"id": "2026-10-13-suriya-01", "client": "Praxis Suriya", "type": "decide|approve|define|route|park-check",
106	 "headline": "plain words: what, why now, what the answer unlocks",
107	 "evidence": ["link or path", "source id"],
108	 "options": {"a": "...", "b": "...", "c": "..."}, "recommended": "a", "why": "one line",
109	 "deadline": "2026-10-14", "created": "2026-10-13", "status": "open|decided|parked|expired",
110	 "answer": null, "park_reason": null, "then": "what the agent does after each option"}
111	```
112	
113	A card that has no recommendation, uses jargon, or takes more than about 1 minute goes back to the agent (R9, R10).
114	
115	### 5.2 Answers
116	- Martin clicks the options (AskUserQuestion, 4 per round, max 2 rounds). Or he types `1a 2p 3b`.
117	- `p` = park. A park needs a reason. The card returns only when the reason changes (R12).
118	- If the answer conflicts with the record, the agent says so with evidence and keeps the card open (R13).
119	- Every answer is written to `state/cards.json` and `<date>/decisions.md` before the agent acts.
120	
121	### 5.2a Walk queue (R24, added after the dry run)
122	Some items are not decisions. They are 1–5 minute clicks that only Martin can do (Wix Publish, Airmailer send, Search Console "Add user", "which drafts did you send?"). They go to a separate **walk queue** with checkboxes. They do not count against the 7 cards. A judgment card becomes a walk item when it has the field `walk` (one line: what, where, minutes).
123	
124	### 5.3 Ranking (standing priorities in `preferences.md`)
125	1. Fire: lost access, angry or worried client, broken site or tracking, legal or HWG risk.
126	2. Money and contract: start dates, payments, renewals, new offers (e.g. Marcel).
127	3. Client deadline within 3 days or a promise made to a client.
128	4. Approval waiting more than 3 days (registry "fertig, Freigabe offen").
129	5. Goal gap: missing goal field, leading number red.
130	6. Pipeline follow-up due.
131	7. Internal 741 work.
132	
133	Inside one level: older first. More than 7 candidates: the extra ones go "below the line" with one line each, and the Monday review proposes defaults for repeated types (R15, R16).
134	
135	## 6. Question bank with conditions
136	
137	Martin's 9 questions become detectors. The agent asks a question only when its condition is true. It never asks what a file already answers.
138	
139	| Q | Martin's question | Condition that creates a card or a line | Card type |
140	|---|---|---|---|
141	| Q1 | Who has urgency? | Any priority-1 to -3 fact (§5.3) | rank only, no own card |
142	| Q2 | Human needed, who must work on it? | Next step of a client is a human task type (§8) and has no owner | route |
143	| Q3 | What must be done, who can do it, what must be prepared? | Human task lacks an input (access, text, photo, approval, budget) | define |
144	| Q4 | Can the agent do it alone? | Task type is "agent alone" in §8 → no card, runs as default. Type unknown → card | route |
145	| Q5 | What activities lead to the result? | Client phase has a next workflow in `workflow-architecture.md` §3 whose gate is open | brief line "next" |
146	| Q6 | Is everything defined (goal, KPI, measurement)? | A goal-sheet field is `null` or older than 90 days | define |
147	| Q7 | Are we aligned (client or 741)? | A client message, chat or memory file contradicts the goal sheet or the plan (e.g. Suriya's new hard rules), or a client is silent > 14 days | decide |
148	| Q8 | Do we hit the goals and KPIs? | Monday only: a weekly number misses its threshold | brief line; card when red 2 weeks |
149	| Q9 | What are the leading factors? | A number is red 3 weeks in a row → question goal and measure (R18) | decide |
150	
151	Extra detectors from the coverage map:
152	- Q10 Approval queue: registry run in "fertig, Freigabe offen" > 3 days → approve card (batch by client).
153	- Q11 Night shift: REVIEW item unread > 1 day, or the same blocker 3 times → card.
154	- Q12 Stale task: portal task overdue > 7 days without a card → card ("done, re-plan, drop").
155	- Q13 Status conflict: two sources disagree (e.g. program start 14.08. vs 03.09.) → define card, once.
156	- Q14 Unhandled client message or help request > 1 day → priority 1.
157	
158	## 7. Client goal sheet
159	
160	File: `00_project/morning-grill-goals.json`. One block per client. The agent fills numbers from baselines and marks them `proposed`. Martin confirms each number with one card (Q6). A number is never invented: no baseline means the field stays `null` and a define card asks for the source.
161	
162	Fields: `client`, `registry_name`, `status` (active / restart / paused / done / lead), `grill` (daily / monday), `phase` (P0–P6 from the architecture map), `program_start`, `program_end`, `quarter_goal` (text), `goal_numbers` [{metric, baseline, target, due, source, status proposed|confirmed}], `leading` [{metric, weekly_threshold, owner}], `next_milestone`, `blockers`, `waiting_for` [{who: client|team|google|martin, what, since}], `client_rules`, `chat` (session id), `next_workflow`.
163	
164	## 8. Human / agent routing
165	
166	| Task type | Who | Handoff |
167	|---|---|---|
168	| Scans, audits, pool, page specs, copy drafts, report drafts, prototypes, review pages | Agent alone (default D6) | Start command in `plan.md`; result in the evening log |
169	| CMS implementation (Elementor, WordPress, Shopify), page publish after Martin's go | Dinakar (Tantri as second) | Portal task + WhatsApp line |
170	| Citations group A, listing verify links, data entry | Tantri | Portal task + WhatsApp line |
171	| Outreach, LinkedIn follow-ups, prospect lists | Gayo | Portal task (team area) + WhatsApp line |
172	| Client calls, client messages, Loom, money, approvals, live-site go, offers | Martin | Card or walk queue (R24) |
173	| Logins, group B listings, review asks, photos, texts from the client | Client | Message draft for Martin (never sent by the agent) |
174	
175	Rules: the agent never marks a task "done" (R26). A new automation starts at level L0, propose only (R22). Stürzl-facing lists name no people; they use "von euch" / "741" (memory `feedback-no-named-task-owners`).
176	
177	## 9. Plan of the day (M2)
178	
179	`<date>/plan.md`, one block per client: **Today** (task, owner, inputs ready yes/no, due) · **Agent starts** (exact chat sentence or slash command, e.g. `/content-write Stürzl <page>`) · **Waiting for** · **Message drafts** (```text blocks, slop-checked 5/5, never sent by the agent).
180	Agent work that Martin approved in the grill can start as new sessions from the grill chat (memory `start-chats-directly-no-offer-card`: `start_session` user_asked, `use_worktree: false`) or continue in the existing client chat (SendMessage to its session id).
181	
182	## 10. Evening log (E1, E2)
183	
184	Draft at 17:00 WITA from the same sources, since the morning bookmark. Per client: **Done** (with link) · **Open** (with owner) · **Tomorrow** (first action) · **Blockers / waiting for** · plus "What agents did while you were away". Martin confirms with one card: confirm / fix lines / add. Unconfirmed logs show first in the next brief. File: `<date>/evening-log.md`; one line per client is also appended to `logs/<client-slug>.md` (running client history).
185	
186	## 11. Weekly and quarterly hooks
187	
188	- **Monday** (in the morning grill, +10 minutes): 741 card (revenue vs `revenue-model-100k.md`, pipeline, capacity, 3 priorities of the week); scorecard per client against the goal sheet; parked cards review; repeated answers → default proposals (R15); to-dos older than 2 weeks → done / re-plan / drop (R30).
189	- **Tracking**: the tracking workflow's weekly card (draft Monday, release Wednesday 12:00) and its red alerts enter the queue as priority 1 (red) or a brief line (yellow).
190	- **Quarter**: the grill hands each client's goal sheet and decision log to the tracking war room. The war room's decisions (date, decision, owner, due, metric, review date) come back as goal-sheet updates.
191	
192	## 12. Storage
193	
194	```
195	00_project/assets/morning-grill/
196	  preferences.md                  # Martin's standing priorities + defaults (read only for the agent)
197	  state/bookmarks.json  cards.json  pulse.log
198	  logs/<client-slug>.md           # one line per day per client
199	  <YYYY-MM-DD>/scan.json  brief.md  brief.html  decisions.md  plan.md  evening-log.md  _run.json
200	00_project/morning-grill-goals.json   # goal sheet (later: portal table, needs GO-DB)
201	00_project/morning-grill-skill/       # skill draft (not installed)
202	```
203	`_run.json`: `{"client": "741 Studio (intern)", "workflow": "morning", ...}` per day, so the overview Excel shows each day.
204	
205	## 13. Automation and safety
206	
207	- Two **Desktop scheduled tasks** (local files needed, R33): 06:00 scan, 17:00 log draft. Setting "keep computer awake". Not cloud routines: they cannot read the local repo (R32).
208	- Before the first unattended run: automation-build layers from `00_project/automation-workflow.md` (L0 propose only; read-only credentials; spend cap 0 € in the scan; pulse log; time zone in the prompt; open and read the first 3 runs, R6.10).
209	- The scan never writes to the portal, Supabase, Drive, a client site, or a message channel.
210	- Cost cap: one scan run ≤ 1 subagent per moved chat, max 12 subagents; Haiku or Sonnet for transcript summaries.
211	
212	## 14. Success measures (after 2 weeks)
213	
214	**Nothing forgotten** (Martin's pick): no overdue portal task, open approval, unanswered client message or help request older than 7 days without a card. Checked by `scripts/validate_brief.py --audit` every Monday.
215	Side measures (logged, not gates): minutes from open to last card; cards per day; parked cards; clients with no logged step in 7 days.

Version 0.2 · 2026-10-13 · Status: DESIGN APPROVED by Martin (checkpoint 1, 2026-10-13). Dry run done (read only). Nothing is installed or scheduled. No portal change. Nothing is sent.
Owner: Martin. Runner: Claude Code Desktop, repo `/Users/martindrendel/741website`. Time zone: **WITA (UTC+8)** for every date and time in this file.
Language: STE. Chat name: `⚙️🧭 Morning Grill`.
Related: research `00_project/knowledge/ops-library/` (rules R1–R40 = `_derived/rules.md`), coverage `00_project/morning-grill-coverage-map.md`, architecture `00_project/workflow-architecture.md`, goal sheet `00_project/morning-grill-goals.json`.

## Contents
0. Job and done · 1. Decisions from the grill · 2. Daily rhythm · 3. Data sources and bookmarks · 4. Morning scan · 5. Decision queue · 6. Question bank · 7. Client goal sheet · 8. Human / agent routing · 9. Plan of the day · 10. Evening log · 11. Weekly and quarterly hooks · 12. Storage · 13. Automation and safety · 14. Success measures · 15. Hard rules · 16. Open points

---

## 0. Job and done

Job in one sentence (R1): **cut Martin's daily decisions to the few that only he can take, and make sure nothing for any client is forgotten.**

Done for one day means all of these are true:
- The brief existed before Martin opened the chat (or the fallback built it in under 3 minutes).
- Martin answered the cards in 10 minutes or less.
- Every active client has a line: today, fixed, watch, next.
- Every human task has an owner, inputs and a due date. Every agent task has a start command.
- At 17:00 the evening log draft exists. Martin confirmed it, or the next grill shows it first.

## 1. Decisions from the grill (2026-10-13)

| # | Topic | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| D1 | Backlinks | **Revised 2026-10-13:** keep both workflows (different outcomes). Citations = consistent listings; Backlink DACH = authority links (pillars B–E), ≥ 8 new referring domains in 90 days. Border: niche directories (jameda, Doctolib, theralupa …) belong to `citations`. The maps playbook only tracks O01–O20. Backlink doc + link library copied from worktree `great-easley-4f6970` to `main`. |
| D2 | Place and length | Desktop chat `⚙️🧭 Morning Grill`, 10 minutes. |
| D3 | Shape | One ranked queue for all clients and 741. Target max 7 cards. |
| D4 | First view | Martin's decisions only. Everything else is below. |
| D5 | Brief time | Pre-built at 06:00 WITA. Fallback: built when Martin opens the chat. |
| D6 | Defaults (no card) | Drafts and read-only scans; team tasks from the approved plan; portal task status to "needs review" (never "done"). |
| D7 | Not a default | Data spend outside a running workflow, anything external, money, launches, live-site changes, client messages. |
| D8 | Handoff to humans | Portal task with all inputs + a ready WhatsApp line for Martin to forward. Portal writes need GO-PORTAL first. Until then the task is a draft in `plan.md`. |
| D9 | Answer format | Clickable cards in chat (AskUserQuestion, 4 per round). Short string `1a 2p 3b` also works. |
| D10 | Goals | Filled for all active clients in this session (see §7 and the goal sheet). |
| D11 | Default numbers | Tracking set. Results: calls, web clicks, routes, real leads, reviews, Maps grid rank. Leading: 741 tasks done per week, pages live, citations live, review asks sent. |
| D12 | Lookback | Since last grill, one bookmark per source. Monday covers the weekend. Failed source = "unreadable". |
| D13 | Evening log | Agent drafts at 17:00 WITA, Martin confirms. "Log the day" runs it at any time. |
| D14 | 741 level | One line every day. A full 741 card every Monday. |
| D15 | Output | Chat + one-page HTML brief (side panel). Portal tab later. |
| D16 | Success | "Nothing forgotten" (§14). |
| D17 | Client status | Active: Suriya, Hüwel, Stürzl, Dumann, Brasse, Bali Healing (now Kunde), Rabenmütter, Johni Jaya Motor (restart), Kamil (reports overdue), me&you/Pauspapier, Marcel (new sales opportunity). Done: Tacheles. |

## 2. Daily rhythm

```
05:50  (existing) nothing — standup still runs at 08:05; the scan calls the standup RPC itself
06:00  M0 SCAN      Desktop scheduled task, read only → scan.json, cards.json, brief.html
any    M1 GRILL     Martin opens ⚙️🧭 Morning Grill → brief link → card rounds (≤ 2 rounds of 4)
+10m   M2 PLAN      answers → plan.md per client + task drafts + WhatsApp lines + agent starts
day    M3 RUN       agents and team work; client chats as usual
17:00  E1 LOG       Desktop scheduled task → evening-log draft per client
any    E2 CONFIRM   Martin confirms or fixes the log (one card) → tomorrow's open list
Mon    W1           741 card + weekly review cards (parked cards, defaults proposals, stale to-dos)

If the Mac slept at 06:00, Desktop runs one catch-up on wake (R33). If the catch-up starts after 12:00, it builds a short brief: fires and decisions only (R8).

## 3. Data sources and bookmarks

Rule: each source has a bookmark in `state/bookmarks.json` (R6.1 of the workflow library). A read error is written as `unreadable` with the error text. It is never "nothing new" (R6.2). Before a new source feeds the brief, the agent shows one real record from it (R5).

| id | Source | How it is read | What it gives | Source of truth for |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| S1 | Session list | `list_sessions` (titles, `lastActivityAt`, worktree, group) | Which client and workflow chats moved | chat activity |

| S5 | Portal standup | RPC `daily_standup()` via `reporting/daily-standup.sh` logic, read only | Program week, onboarding, missing access, help requests, unread messages, overdue tasks | program, tasks, client messages |
| S6 | Night shift | `reporting/night-shift/<date>/REVIEW.md` | Drafts waiting for review, repeat blockers | overnight drafts |
| S7 | Citations | `client_citations` (planned > 14 days), `listing_emails` (handled = false) | Stuck listings, verify links | listings |
| S8 | Tracking | Early warnings from the tracking workflow (when built); until then Local Falcon MCP GBP reads only on Monday | Calls, clicks, routes, reviews | proof numbers |
| S9 | Memory | Client memory files changed since the bookmark | New rules, client facts | client rules |
| S10 | Calendar | Google Calendar MCP, today and tomorrow | Calls and deadlines today | meetings |
| S11 | Yesterday | `<yesterday>/evening-log.md`, `state/cards.json` | Carry-over, open and parked cards (R7) | commitments |
| S12 | 741 level | `00_project/revenue-model-100k.md`, prospects `_run.json`, lead memory files | Pipeline line, follow-ups due | agency numbers |

Not read in v1: Gmail and WhatsApp (no connector with read rights for WhatsApp; Gmail later, read only).

## 4. Morning scan (M0)

Steps, all read only:
1. Read `preferences.md` (Martin's standing priorities and defaults; the agent cannot edit it) (R3.7 of the workflow library).
2. Read bookmarks. Read S1–S12. Write `scan.json` with one block per client plus a 741 block. Each fact carries its source id and a link.
3. Run the detectors (§6). Each hit becomes a card candidate or a brief line.
4. Rank card candidates (§5.3). Keep max 7. Batch related ones. Move the rest to "below the line".
5. Render `brief.html` (template `templates/morning-grill-brief.html`) and `brief.md`.
6. Validate with `scripts/validate_brief.py`: every card has options, a recommendation, a deadline and an evidence link; no card older than 3 days without a decision or park reason; every active client has a line. Fix until it passes.
7. Write `_run.json`, the pulse line in `state/pulse.log`, and move the bookmarks.

## 5. Decision queue

### 5.1 Decision card format (R9)

```json
{"id": "2026-10-13-suriya-01", "client": "Praxis Suriya", "type": "decide|approve|define|route|park-check",
 "headline": "plain words: what, why now, what the answer unlocks",
 "evidence": ["link or path", "source id"],
 "options": {"a": "...", "b": "...", "c": "..."}, "recommended": "a", "why": "one line",
 "deadline": "2026-10-14", "created": "2026-10-13", "status": "open|decided|parked|expired",
 "answer": null, "park_reason": null, "then": "what the agent does after each option"}
```

A card that has no recommendation, uses jargon, or takes more than about 1 minute goes back to the agent (R9, R10).

### 5.2 Answers
- Martin clicks the options (AskUserQuestion, 4 per round, max 2 rounds). Or he types `1a 2p 3b`.
- `p` = park. A park needs a reason. The card returns only when the reason changes (R12).
- If the answer conflicts with the record, the agent says so with evidence and keeps the card open (R13).
- Every answer is written to `state/cards.json` and `<date>/decisions.md` before the agent acts.

### 5.2a Walk queue (R24, added after the dry run)
Some items are not decisions. They are 1–5 minute clicks that only Martin can do (Wix Publish, Airmailer send, Search Console "Add user", "which drafts did you send?"). They go to a separate **walk queue** with checkboxes. They do not count against the 7 cards. A judgment card becomes a walk item when it has the field `walk` (one line: what, where, minutes).

### 5.3 Ranking (standing priorities in `preferences.md`)
1. Fire: lost access, angry or worried client, broken site or tracking, legal or HWG risk.
2. Money and contract: start dates, payments, renewals, new offers (e.g. Marcel).
3. Client deadline within 3 days or a promise made to a client.
4. Approval waiting more than 3 days (registry "fertig, Freigabe offen").
5. Goal gap: missing goal field, leading number red.
6. Pipeline follow-up due.
7. Internal 741 work.

Inside one level: older first. More than 7 candidates: the extra ones go "below the line" with one line each, and the Monday review proposes defaults for repeated types (R15, R16).

## 6. Question bank with conditions

| Q | Martin's question | Condition that creates a card or a line | Card type |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q1 | Who has urgency? | Any priority-1 to -3 fact (§5.3) | rank only, no own card |

| Q4 | Can the agent do it alone? | Task type is "agent alone" in §8 → no card, runs as default. Type unknown → card | route |
| Q5 | What activities lead to the result? | Client phase has a next workflow in `workflow-architecture.md` §3 whose gate is open | brief line "next" |

| Q9 | What are the leading factors? | A number is red 3 weeks in a row → question goal and measure (R18) | decide |
